title: Israel sends more troops to West Bank town besieged by settlers
gist: A short Al-Monitor Brief podcast segment notes Turkey outlined plans to strengthen ties with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan following their defense pact, while Iran pushed back against US claims over the Strait of Hormuz.

insights.claim: Turkey outlined plans to strengthen ties with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan following the trio's defense pact.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Follow-on diplomatic steps after the defense pact signal the Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan alignment is moving from announcement to implementation.
insights.locator: Turkey outlined how it plans to strengthen ties
